# BAD-079 — Unit-pin wrapGraceOpen and the WRAP_GRACE_MS + UPLOAD_URL_TTL_MS < WRAPPED_TTL_MS ordering in test/server/collab.test.mjs

## Brief
BAD-063 added wrapGraceOpen, WRAP_GRACE_MS and UPLOAD_URL_TTL_MS to _shared/collab.mjs. The integration suite pins the behaviour end to end, but the pure predicate has no stack-free test the way claimLapsed/claimRecording do, and the ordering that keeps a grace from outliving retention (WRAP_GRACE_MS + UPLOAD_URL_TTL_MS strictly below WRAPPED_TTL_MS) is unpinned. test/server/collab.test.mjs is where the sibling pins live and was outside BAD-063's deliverables.

Evidence: server/supabase/functions/_shared/collab.mjs (wrapGraceOpen, WRAP_GRACE_MS, UPLOAD_URL_TTL_MS); test/server/collab.test.mjs lines 160-192 pin the sibling clocks and predicates; test/server/functions.test.mjs 'a wrap with a take in flight finishes inside commit…' is the integration pin.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children: a single test file, two additions, no production code. Test-only, so the whole proof is a green npm test on the branch; opus rather than sonnet because the pins have to read the predicate's deliberate asymmetries right (an unreadable wrapped_at must refuse where collabExpired's null admits) rather than merely exercise the happy path.
